```{r CDC dataset imputation }
library(tidymodels)
library(mice)
library(mitools)

na_if_brfss <- function(x, miss_codes) {
  x <- as.numeric(x)
  x[x %in% miss_codes] <- NA
  x
}

income_dat <- brfss_ca %>%
  select(
    INCOME3,
    EDUCA,
    EMPLOY1,
    `_AGEG5YR`,
    `_IMPRACE`,
    MARITAL,
    SEXVAR,
    `_HLTHPLN`,
    GENHLTH,
    `_SMOKER3`,
    `_LLCPWT`,
    `_STSTR`,
    `_PSU`
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    INCOME3 = na_if_brfss(INCOME3, c(77, 99)),
    EDUCA = na_if_brfss(EDUCA, c(9)),
    EMPLOY1 = na_if_brfss(EMPLOY1, c(9)),
    MARITAL = na_if_brfss(MARITAL, c(9)),
    GENHLTH = na_if_brfss(GENHLTH, c(7, 9)),
    `_AGEG5YR` = as.numeric(`_AGEG5YR`),
    `_IMPRACE` = as.numeric(`_IMPRACE`),
    SEXVAR = as.numeric(SEXVAR),
    `_HLTHPLN` = as.numeric(`_HLTHPLN`),
    `_SMOKER3` = as.numeric(`_SMOKER3`)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    INCOME3 = factor(INCOME3, ordered = TRUE),
    EDUCA = factor(EDUCA, ordered = TRUE),
    EMPLOY1 = factor(EMPLOY1),
    `_AGEG5YR` = factor(`_AGEG5YR`, ordered = TRUE),
    `_IMPRACE` = factor(`_IMPRACE`),
    MARITAL = factor(MARITAL),
    SEXVAR = factor(SEXVAR),
    `_HLTHPLN` = factor(`_HLTHPLN`),
    GENHLTH = factor(GENHLTH, ordered = TRUE),
    `_SMOKER3` = factor(`_SMOKER3`, ordered = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  filter(!(is.na(INCOME3) &
           is.na(EDUCA) &
           is.na(EMPLOY1) &
           is.na(MARITAL) &
           is.na(GENHLTH) &
           is.na(`_SMOKER3`)))

md.pattern(income_dat)

meth <- make.method(income_dat)
meth[] <- ""
meth["INCOME3"] <- "polyreg"

pred <- make.predictorMatrix(income_dat)
pred[,] <- 0

pred["INCOME3", c(
  "EDUCA", "EMPLOY1", "_AGEG5YR", "_IMPRACE", "MARITAL", "SEXVAR",
  "_HLTHPLN", "GENHLTH", "_SMOKER3", "_LLCPWT"
)] <- 1

pred["INCOME3", c("_STSTR", "_PSU")] <- 0
pred["INCOME3", "INCOME3"] <- 0

imp <- mice(
  income_dat,
  m = 20,
  method = meth,
  predictorMatrix = pred,
  maxit = 20,
  seed = 232839,
  printFlag = FALSE
)

plot(imp)
stripplot(imp, INCOME3 ~ .imp)

imp_list <- complete(imp, action = "all")

sapply(imp_list, function(d) sum(is.na(d$INCOME3)))

options(survey.lonely.psu = "adjust")

designs <- lapply(imp_list, function(d) {
  svydesign(
    ids = ~`_PSU`,
    strata = ~`_STSTR`,
    weights = ~`_LLCPWT`,
    data = d,
    nest = TRUE
  )
})

fits <- lapply(designs, function(des) {
  svyolr(
    INCOME3 ~ EDUCA + EMPLOY1 + `_AGEG5YR` + `_IMPRACE` +
      GENHLTH + SEXVAR + MARITAL + `_HLTHPLN` + `_SMOKER3`,
    design = des
  )
})

pooled <- MIcombine(
  results = lapply(fits, coef),
  variances = lapply(fits, vcov)
)

summary(pooled)

```
```{r}
#Imputed odds ratio
est <- summary(pooled)

OR <- exp(est$results)
lower <- exp(est$results - 1.96 * est$se)
upper <- exp(est$results + 1.96 * est$se)

out <- data.frame(
  term = rownames(est),
  estimate = est$results,
  SE = est$se,
  OR = OR,
  CI_lower = lower,
  CI_upper = upper
)

out

cc_dat <- income_dat %>%
  filter(!is.na(INCOME3))

cc_des <- svydesign(
  ids = ~`_PSU`,
  strata = ~`_STSTR`,
  weights = ~`_LLCPWT`,
  data = cc_dat,
  nest = TRUE
)

cc_fit <- svyolr(
  INCOME3 ~ EDUCA + EMPLOY1 + `_AGEG5YR` + `_IMPRACE` +
    GENHLTH + SEXVAR + MARITAL + `_HLTHPLN` +
    `_SMOKER3`,design = cc_des
)

summary(cc_fit)
```

```{r}
imp_long <- bind_rows(
  lapply(seq_along(imp_list), function(i) {
    imp_list[[i]] %>%
      mutate(.imp = i)
  }))

income_dist <- imp_long %>%
  group_by(.imp, INCOME3) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(.imp) %>%
  mutate(prop = n / sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(INCOME3) %>%
  summarise(mean_prop = mean(prop))

ggplot(income_dist, aes(x = INCOME3, y = mean_prop)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity",fill = "orange", alpha = 0.6) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Imputed Income",
    x = "Income",
    y = "Proportion"
  )
```

```{r}

obs_income <- brfss_ca %>%
  count(INCOME3) %>%
  mutate(
    prop = n / sum(n),
    source = "Observed",
    INCOME3 = as.character(INCOME3),
    income_label = case_when(
      INCOME3 == "1" ~ "<10k",
      INCOME3 == "2" ~ "10–15k",
      INCOME3 == "3" ~ "15–20k",
      INCOME3 == "4" ~ "20–25k",
      INCOME3 == "5" ~ "25–35k",
      INCOME3 == "6" ~ "35–50k",
      INCOME3 == "7" ~ "50–75k",
      INCOME3 == "8" ~ "75–100k",
      INCOME3 == "9" ~ "100–150k",
      INCOME3 == "10" ~ "150–200k",
      INCOME3 == "11" ~ ">200k",
      INCOME3 == "77" ~ "Don't know",
      INCOME3 == "99" ~ "Refused"
    )
  )

imp_income <- imp_long %>%
  filter(!is.na(INCOME3)) %>%
  mutate(INCOME3 = as.character(INCOME3)) %>%
  group_by(.imp, INCOME3) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(.imp) %>%
  mutate(prop = n / sum(n)) %>%
  group_by(INCOME3) %>%
  summarise(prop = mean(prop)) %>%
  mutate(
    source = "Imputed",
    income_label = case_when(
      INCOME3 == "1" ~ "<10k",
      INCOME3 == "2" ~ "10–15k",
      INCOME3 == "3" ~ "15–20k",
      INCOME3 == "4" ~ "20–25k",
      INCOME3 == "5" ~ "25–35k",
      INCOME3 == "6" ~ "35–50k",
      INCOME3 == "7" ~ "50–75k",
      INCOME3 == "8" ~ "75–100k",
      INCOME3 == "9" ~ "100–150k",
      INCOME3 == "10" ~ "150–200k",
      INCOME3 == "11" ~ ">200k"
    )
  )
income_compare <- bind_rows(obs_income, imp_income)
```

```{r}
ggplot(income_compare, aes(x = income_label, y = prop, fill = source)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  labs(
    title = "Income Distribution: Observed vs Imputed",
    x = "Income Category",
    y = "Proportion"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Observed" = "steelblue", "Imputed" = "orange")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

```{r NA Check function}
na_summary <- function(data, only_na = FALSE) {
  
  na_count <- colSums(is.na(data))
  na_percent <- colMeans(is.na(data)) * 100
  
  result <- data.frame(
    variable = names(na_count),
    na_count = na_count,
    na_percent = round(na_percent, 2)
  )
  
  if (only_na) {
    result <- result[result$na_count > 0, ]
  }
  
  return(result)
}
```
